49191f83598c43ce2b1c92d596f8aa99.overview: A photographer takes up newsreel shooting to impress a secretary.
49191f83598c43ce2b1c92d596f8aa99.tagline: You'll laugh yourself completely out of focus!

491d7d0bf7ceca51e7091cc21ddd6bfc.overview: When his best friend dies of a heart attack, Ray Macklin becomes a man obsessed with his own mortality. Convinced that all his aches and pains are an indication of his imminent death, Ray's life turns into a slapstick farce of health-crazed anxiety and hypochondria.
491d7d0bf7ceca51e7091cc21ddd6bfc.tagline: Nine out of ten doctors say Ray is perfectly healthy. But what do they know?

49280f30032656209d0fe67d6b868b25.overview: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

49544c78dd1607355c0efba6a2055271.overview: A pastor of a small church in upstate New York starts to spiral out of control after a soul-shaking encounter with an unstable environmental activist and his pregnant wife.

4979aea0e4ab7600d86d706fe69c24e7.overview: Former detective Nick Charles has retired from police work, preferring a life of cocktails, parties, and relaxation with his wealthy wife, Nora. Their holiday is interrupted when the daughter of Nick’s former client asks for help finding her missing father, eccentric inventor Clyde Wynant. When Wynant’s body is discovered, Nick is drawn back into the investigation, with Nora eagerly joining him. As the couple questions Wynant’s family, friends, and business associates, a tangled web of greed, deception, and murder begins to unravel.
4979aea0e4ab7600d86d706fe69c24e7.tagline: A laugh tops every thrilling moment!

49ba48cce72dbb90b1bf3a9aa03e51d5.overview: An unemployed Brit vents his rage on unsuspecting strangers as he embarks on a nocturnal London odyssey.

49c1575389304ae1cb74f52a25259fc8.overview: Eleven-year-old Kevin's passion for history is put to the test when he joins a ragtag group of time-traveling thieves on a high-stakes and hilarious adventure.
